about_the_game:
Welcome to the future! The Cyberpunk DLC brings a brand-new environment that pulls you into a world of neon lights, where new mechanics and plenty of levels await you.

  • A glowing futuristic environment full of digital atmosphere
  • 30 new levels filled with tricky puzzles and obstacles
  • Unique blocks expanding gameplay and level editor – city barrier, force field, recoloring laser
  • New cyber look for your cubes

Overcome tech traps and master the neon maze! Do you have what it takes to beat the digital world?
